questions.question: Whom does Isaiah 51 call to listen?
options: The kings and the rulers of all of the nations
The wealthy ones who give freely to the poor
The priests who faithfully serve at the holy altar
Those who pursue righteousness and seek the LORD
questions.answer: Those who pursue righteousness and seek the LORD
